description: This file contains implementation code for a Vulkan-based fullscreen texture rendering sample, including setup of images, shaders, descriptor sets, pipeline creation, and frame recording.

classes.name: FullscreenTexture
classes.description: A class implementing a Vulkan fullscreen textured rendering sample, managing resources, pipeline, and rendering logic.

methods.name: BuildVulkanSampleApp
methods.description: Builds and returns a Vulkan sample application instance.

methods.name: FullscreenTexture::Create
methods.description: Static method to create and initialize a FullscreenTexture instance.

methods.name: FullscreenTexture::StartUp
methods.description: Initializes resources, images, shaders, and pipeline for the fullscreen texture sample.

methods.name: FullscreenTexture::CleanUp
methods.description: Cleans up resources used by the sample.

methods.name: FullscreenTexture::CreateSwapchainDependents
methods.description: Creates resources dependent on the swapchain, such as framebuffers and render pass.

methods.name: FullscreenTexture::RecordFrame
methods.description: Records commands to render a fullscreen textured quad for a frame.
